name: Door in 5
purpose: Hyper-local to national courier and delivery platform. Buyer, Seller, Driver, and Admin apps with dispatch automation and Stripe payments. Launching first in Tunbridge Wells.
current_blocker: No complete end-to-end delivery flow that a real person can use and pay for today.
next_task: Define and build the absolute minimum viable delivery: one real job from posting to completion plus payment.
next_milestone: One real person in Tunbridge Wells can post a job, a driver can accept and complete it, and payment processes.
fastest_route_to_revenue: Get 5-10 real paid deliveries happening in Tunbridge Wells within 30 days.
time_to_first_sale: 2-4 weeks if we cut scope ruthlessly
